title: Korean Strawberry Milk Bingsu
hookLine: Fluffy frozen condensed-milk snow grated with a fork—no shaved-ice machine required.

items.name: Mini mochi bites or cheesecake cubes

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {milk_bg} and {straw_bg} and keep toppings like {mochi_bg} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Freeze Milk Flat & Fork-Fluff
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze {milk_bg} in a zip bag flat for 3 hours (or grate frozen milk cubes with a microplane/fork into fluffy snow). Line your chilling pan or tray with parchment paper for easy lifting, and keep {milk_bg} measured and ready to combine.

steps.title: Top with Berries & Mochi
steps.instructionTemplate: Pile snowy flakes into a chilled bowl and top with {straw_bg}, {mochi_bg}, and an extra condensed-milk swirl. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 2 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill your serving bowl in the freezer for 10 minutes first so the snow stays airy.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Korean Strawberry Milk Bingsu flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 2 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.
